Published - November 15, 2026 07:33 am IST - Mount Maunganui
FIle photo of Yash Thakur. Yash Thakur will be making his ODI debut against New Zealand in the fifth ODI, in Mount Maunganui. FIle | Photo Credit: The Hindu
New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner won the toss and elected to bowl against India in the series-deciding fifth and final ODI in Mount Maunganui on Sunday (November 15, 2026).
India lead the series 2-1 having won the first two ODIs of the series, while the third match was washed out. The visitors lost the fourth ODI by a huge margin of 244 runs.
But India’s Gurnoor Brar and New Zealand’s Matt Henry and Kyle Jamieson will miss the final ODI as they move on to prepare for the two-Test series starting on November 19.
India: Rohit Sharma, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer (c), Ishan Kishan (wk), Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Auqib Nabi, Arshdeep Singh, Mohammed Siraj, Yash Thakur.
New Zealand: Tim Seifert (wk), Will Young, Nick Kelly, Dean Foxcroft, Finn Allen, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (c), Kristian Clarke, Blair Tickner, Jacob Duffy, Matthew Fisher.
